note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). Convertible to skill-creator's eval format; run via its description-tuning loop or manual fresh-session baseline.

cases.prompt: What's the state of the project?
Where are we? Give me a status overview of everything in flight.
What's blocked on me right now?
Give me a project state report
Review all roadmap, plan, and backlog items and the open tickets
Which branches and worktrees can be merged, deleted, or closed?
What changed since I last checked in on this repo?
cases.comment: ruling reversed 2026-08-19 (#720): 'since I last checked in' is checkpoint-relative, not a calendar window — it matches check-state's own 'Delta since last run' verdict bullet verbatim, not what-shipped's date-bounded ask (its own boundary line names 'a window of activity' — today/yesterday/this week/36h/a date range — as its axis, and cedes 'current work-state...a point-in-time snapshot' to check-state). Supersedes the 2026-07-30 cede (PR #121); no reciprocal case existed in what-shipped's own suite to flip alongside it.

cases.prompt: Are there any open PRs waiting on my review or failing CI?
Do our plan docs still match the open issues, or have they drifted?
I'm back after a week off — catch me up on where this repo stands.
What should I work on next? Prioritize the backlog for me.
cases.comment: owner: chore-planner (action queue, not a report)

cases.prompt: Clean up the stale branches and remove the dead worktrees.
Is the plugin estate healthy? Run the health sweep.
File this as a follow-up task so we don't lose it.
Run the whole ops sweep — dispatch all the standing seats.
Triage the new issues that came in overnight.
What's the status of this one PR — is #42 ready to merge?
cases.comment: single-item question; plain gh lookup, no report needed. Fenced 2026-08-12 (#173) with a NOT-single-PR/issue clause on the description, per the 2026-08-12 check-routing leak (row n07, harness-audit-2026-08-11/routing/report.md)

cases.prompt: Write the release report artifact for this session.
Wrap up this session — anything left hanging in the worktree?
Anything still open or unanswered from our conversation?
cases.comment: owner: find-open-questions (session backlog, not repo state)

cases.prompt: Sweep this chat for leftover work
cases.comment: owner: docs file-leftovers (conversation evidence, not repo state)

cases.prompt: What shipped today? Summarize the PRs that merged.
cases.comment: owner: what-shipped (window of activity; this skill is the point-in-time work-state snapshot)

cases.prompt: Which lifecycle loop is this project emphasizing right now — North star, Foundation, or Releases?
cases.comment: owner: docs:check-stage (lifecycle-position axis, not work-state; reciprocal fence added 2026-08-16, issue #336)

cases.prompt: Give me a state rollup across every repo our fleet touches.
Check whether this repo's plugin fixes have actually landed in gen-ui-kit yet, or if it's still running the old cached copy.
cases.comment: --fleet scope's drift check (the #582 stale-copy case), #620. Description-fixed 2026-08-19 (#733, surfaced by #720's full-suite re-judge: stolen 3-of-3 by plugin-install-facts, whose own t14 'my installed plugin never got the update' is a near-paraphrase). Added trigger-voice phrasing to the --fleet clause matching this prompt's own vocabulary ('has a fix landed in another repo yet, or is it still on the old cached copy') to disambiguate the cross-repo drift REPORT (this skill) from a person's own single-install update-lag troubleshooting (plugin-install-facts). Reciprocal fence + negative case added on plugin-install-facts.

cases.prompt: Where is my session's transcript — the .jsonl file for this run?
cases.comment: owner: harness:runtime-state (session .jsonl transcript locator, not project work-state; reciprocal fence added 2026-08-19, issue #605)
